{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df_clean = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by channel
# But first, check if the groups are comparable
# Cross-tabulate channel vs segment to see if they are confounded
channel_segment = pd.crosstab(sales_df_clean['channel'], sales_df_clean['customer_segment'])
print("Cleaned data: Channel vs Segment cross-tab:\n", channel_segment)

# Compute conversion rate for each channel on the cleaned data
conv_rate_email = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conv_rate_paid_search = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

print(f"Conversion rate email: {conv_rate_email:.3f}")
print(f"Conversion rate paid_search: {conv_rate_paid_search:.3f}")

# Compute revenue per order by channel
revenue_email = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['revenue'].mean()
revenue_paid_search = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue'].mean()

print(f"Average revenue email: {revenue_email:.2f}")
print(f"Average revenue paid_search: {revenue_paid_search:.2f}")

# Check if the difference in conversion is due to segment imbalance
# Stratify by segment and compute conversion rate within each segment
conv_by_segment = sales_df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Conversion rate by channel and segment:\n", conv_by_segment)

# Also compute revenue by segment
revenue_by_segment = sales_df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Average revenue by channel and segment:\n", revenue_by_segment)"}
